text.description_html:
First Impressions CF3401/36-SS 36 Inch Stainless Appliance Pull

Very Contemporary Two Tone stainless steel appliance pull from First Impressions. The 1-1/2" wide back flat portion of the pull is Satin stainless steel and the front raised portion is Polished stainless steel.

Specifications of First Impressions CF3401/36-SS Appliance Pull

  • Pull Length: 36"
  • Pull Width: 1-1/2"
  • Projection: 2-1/8"
  • Finish: Satin Stainless (bottom) with Polished Stainless (top)
  • Material: Stainless Steel



Note: This appliance handle is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths up to 6 feet. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the appliance handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged with mounting screws for a standard 3/4" - 1" thick refrigerator/appliance door panel.

*Sold individually.
